# Repo-wide exemptions for scripts/pr-security-scan.mjs.
#
#   <rule-id> <path-glob>
#
# `*` matches within a path segment, `**` across segments. Prefer an inline
# `pr-security-scan: allow <rule-id>` comment on the offending line: it sits
# next to the thing it excuses and disappears with it. This file is for a rule
# that is structurally wrong for a whole directory.
#
# Editing this file is itself a blocking finding (`security-gate-modified`), so
# a pull request cannot quietly widen its own exemptions -- which is the point,
# and why it starts empty. Nothing in the repository currently needs an entry.
